extracted_text: Email screenshot received September 4, 2026. Melissa Douglas (Worldpay) forwarded a thread to Bryan Bailey, Todd Vahlsing, and Brendan Crockett with the comment: "Not a great look for us. Can we get our arms around the Genius team reaching out to our merchants?" The forwarded customer email is from MJ Worsham, Vice President, Restaurant Technology, Five Guys, sent Friday, September 4, 2026 at 7:48 AM to Mark Brage, Jazmin Hamilton, Avery Churchwell, and Melissa Douglas, subject "RE: A quick benchmark for Five Guys." MJ wrote: "Hi Mark, Thanks for the note – we are already working with Worldpay on our day to day as a long-term customer and have no interest in evaluating any other solutions from Global Payments at this time. We will continue to work through Avery and Melissa if that changes. Best, MJ."
